How to Play

1️⃣ You will complete 5 picture levels.

2️⃣ Each picture has blanks with an arrow pointing to a kitchen item.

3️⃣ Drag the matching word from the word bank into each blank, then press Check to see the answers.

4️⃣ After all 5 levels, a Submission page adds them up and shows your total score. (Take your screenshot there!)

Tip: you can also tap a word, then tap a blank to place it. Tap a filled blank to take the word back.
